I keep my iPhone 15 on silent at night but I still want a light to flash when something comes in. Can it do that? How do I set it up?

Here is how to set up the light for alerts.
1. Open the **Settings** app, tap **Accessibility**, then tap **Audio/Visual**.
2. Turn on **LED Flash for Alerts**.
3. Make sure **Flash on Silent** is turned on, so the light still flashes while your iPhone is in silent mode. Turn it off only if you don't want LED flashes in silent mode.
LED Flash for Alerts works only when your device is locked.
